body:
Four Calendar popup probes are evaluated against the current release: deferred event normalization, delegated keyboard handling, removing the main-grid component wrapper and constraining first opening by the measured grid height. Seven-round matched release comparisons establish no useful repeatable gain. The initial opening-bound improvement from 307 to 299 ms reverses to 302 to 305 ms in a quiet repeat. All application prototypes are restored.

All 560 timing samples retain complete popup IDs, titles and versions and current source response checks. The 280 Calendar openings retain one Calendar GET, 140 popup openings zero reads and 140 editor openings exactly source/project/tags. Restored focused tests and type/build checks pass; frontend assets match the deployed build. A saved hot CPU frame is identified from its exact compiled bytes as native dialog opening, not chunk sorting.

The existing manual application remains the verified editor read-overlap build; trusted HTTPS/root bytes and the owner card are unchanged. No application restart or new full acceptance run is claimed for this documentation result. Evidence: progress/2026-10-01-calendar-popup-probes.md. Native DOM/layout/rendering costs and the broader performance and release objective remain open.

metadata.summary: Calendar popup probes rejected after matched release measurements
